This product is supplied without battery and charger. DeWalt 5.0ah batteries now on offer! Please see product code 6328D.

First fix framing nail gun for timber framing, stud work and roof battens. Features tougher driver blade and magnesium magazine for enhanced durability. Fires angled nails from 50 to 90mm and fits between 400mm joist centres. Internals help to deliver more power to drive nails more consistently and faster. Ease of operation with increased depth adjustment, an improved magazine loading system and metal rafter hook. Bump and sequential operation modes for precision placement and faster application.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
